subregion.name: Central Tribunal
subregion.summary: A spacious complex of high-ceilinged halls functioning as the primary northern crossroads.

subregion.name: Deep Sanctum
subregion.summary: The southernmost tier of secluded vaults and solemn stone halls.

subregion.name: Eastern Annex
subregion.summary: A quiet peripheral wing of halls and alcoves guarding the far eastern flank.

subregion.name: Eastern Undercroft
subregion.summary: A split-level network of vaulted chambers and corridors nestled in the northeast.

subregion.name: Lower Crossroads
subregion.summary: A bustling nexus of mid-level thoroughfares and branching corridors.

subregion.name: Northern Colonnade
subregion.summary: A grand avenue of connected halls lining the northern perimeter.

subregion.name: Northwest Cloisters
subregion.summary: A secluded network of quiet cells and small vaulted passageways at the far northwestern corner.

subregion.name: Pillar Court
subregion.summary: An expansive assembly floor dominated by large colonnaded reception halls.

subregion.name: Scholar Chambers
subregion.summary: Densely clustered study rooms and domestic lodgings west of the central courts.

subregion.name: Southern Nave
subregion.summary: A broad, linear corridor of stately halls leading toward the lower sanctuary.

subregion.name: West Galleries
subregion.summary: A series of interconnected exhibition halls and antechambers in the lower western wing.

subregion.name: Western Catacombs
subregion.summary: An isolated series of elongated vaults and narrow side chambers along the western boundary.
